sobreNosotros.title: More than software
sobreNosotros.subhead: We build technology with life, so communities, schools and businesses can spend their time on what matters.
paragraphs: Two Jews, two different paths and one shared idea. Wherever we looked we saw the same thing: extraordinary communities held together by scattered WhatsApp groups, spreadsheets and hours of volunteer work that technology should handle effortlessly.

That's where we started, with Kehál, the community app that Chabad Barcelona uses today. Along the way, businesses with the same need to get organised and grow called us: a kippah brand, a parasha study tool, a property developer, a coffee brand. And Jewish schools brought us their own challenge.

Today we work across all three areas with the same approach: listen first, build to measure and stay alongside you after launch. For us it is also a way of giving something back to the community that shaped us.
sobreNosotros.pullQuote: Because when communities thrive, Judaism thrives.

founders.name: Isaac Ayash Belilty
founders.quote: I believe technology should remove obstacles, so community leaders can focus on people.

hero.title: Your community's life, in an app that carries its name.
hero.subtitle: Kehál brings membership, the Hebrew calendar, events, mikveh, donations and Torah together in one place, with your kehilla's colours, logo and languages. The whole app, or just the modules you need.
hero.ctaSecondary: Talk to us about your community

modulos.title: The whole app, or just what you need
modulos.intro: Kehál is built from modules. You can start with events and donations and add the mikveh or the directory later. Each module works on its own and they all share the same members.

items.title: Membership
items.body: Member sign-up with identity verification and manual approval by the team. Nobody joins without the community knowing.

items.title: Hebrew calendar
items.body: Hebrew dates, holidays, the weekly parasha and halachic times for your city, always up to date.

items.title: Events with capacity
items.body: One-click sign-up, limited places and an attendee list for the team, no spreadsheets.

items.title: Mikveh
items.body: Appointment booking with discretion and privacy, on the schedule the community sets.

items.title: Donations by area
items.body: Each donation goes to the area the donor chooses: education, kashrut, welfare or whatever you define.

items.title: Life cycle
items.body: Requests for Bar and Bat Mitzvah, Brit Milah, weddings and Nachala, tracked in one place.

items.title: Torah and shiurim
items.body: Classes, materials and Torah content to learn during the week.

items.title: Jconnect
items.body: Jewish Business & Co-Work directory: members list their business and find people to work with.

items.title: Admin dashboard
items.body: Members, events, donations, bookings and communications managed from a single dashboard.

identidad.title: With your community's identity
identidad.body: It isn't a generic app with your logo stuck on. Together we choose the name, colours, logo, languages and what appears on the home screen, so every member feels the app belongs to their community.

caso.title: Chabad Barcelona
caso.body: Kehál is the website and app of the Chabad Barcelona community, at bcnkehila.com. Members log in with their account, newcomers request access and the team approves it. Events, mikveh, donations and the calendar, all in one place.
caso.statLabel: members on the app, out of a community of more than 750
caso.screenshotAlt: Screenshots of the Chabad Barcelona app

cta.title: Shall we talk about your community?
cta.body: Tell us how you organise things today and we'll show you Kehál with your name and colours.

demo.title: Try it yourself
demo.intro: This is the real app, with a sample community. Log in as a member or as an admin and move around it as you would on your phone.

meta.title: A dedicated app for Jewish schools | Chai Active
meta.description: Academic tracking, communication with families and Jewish life built into an app with your school's identity. We are looking for pilot schools.

hero.title: School life at a Jewish school, in one app with its own identity.
hero.subtitle: We have designed a dedicated app for students, teachers and families: grades, homework, attendance and messages in one place, with the Hebrew calendar and Jewish life built in. We are in conversations with schools in Barcelona and ready to start with pilot schools.
hero.ctaSecondary: Let's start with a pilot group

pilares.title: Three pillars
pilares.intro: What we have learned from talking with schools comes down to three things a school app has to do well.

items.title: Continuous academic tracking
items.body: Grades, homework and attendance up to date, so nobody discovers a problem at the end-of-term meeting.

items.title: Direct, organised communication
items.body: Messages, notices and permission slips in one channel, without relying on stray emails or WhatsApp groups.

items.title: Identity and community
items.body: The app carries the school's name and colours, and Jewish life is built in, not bolted on at the end.

perfiles.title: Six profiles. Each sees only what is theirs.
perfiles.intro: Everyone logs in with their own account and sees what applies to them. Roles can be combined: a teacher who is also a mother uses one account and switches view.

items.title: Student
items.body: Their timetable, homework, grades and messages from their teachers.

items.title: Family or legal guardian
items.body: Each child's day to day, notices, permission slips and meetings.

items.title: Teacher
items.body: Their groups, taking the register, marking and talking to students and families.

items.title: Form tutor or co-tutor
items.body: The full view of their class and the progress of each student.

items.title: Coordination and head of studies
items.body: Timetables, cover, exam calendar and reports by stage.

items.title: Leadership and administration
items.body: School settings, permissions, documents and overall indicators.

perfiles.security: Least privilege: nobody sees more than they need. And every access to a student's data is logged.

app.title: The app in five sections
app.intro: Simple navigation with five tabs at the bottom. Anything people check often is two taps away at most. Tap the tabs on the phone to see it.

capaJudia.title: Jewish life, inside the app
capaJudia.intro: This is what a generic school platform cannot give you. The Jewish calendar is not an add-on: it shapes the school year.

items.title: Hebrew calendar
items.body: Dual dates, Gregorian and Hebrew, throughout the app.

items.title: Holidays in the school calendar
items.body: Holidays adjust the school calendar automatically, without redoing it by hand every year.

items.title: Shabbat times for Barcelona
items.body: Candle lighting and the end of Shabbat calculated for the city.

items.title: Shabbat and holiday warnings
items.body: If someone schedules an exam or a hand-in on Shabbat or a holiday, the app warns them before saving.

items.title: Shabbat mode
items.body: Optional silencing of notifications during Shabbat and a summary afterwards.

items.title: Jewish studies and Hebrew
items.body: Real right-to-left writing and nikud in homework, notes and exams.

items.title: Kosher canteen
items.body: The canteen menu with its kashrut information.

items.title: Tzedakah and volunteering
items.body: Tzedakah campaigns and a log of volunteering hours.

items.title: Community calendar
items.body: The Barcelona Jewish community's calendar alongside the school's.

items.title: Four languages
items.body: Spanish, Catalan, English and Hebrew.

capaJudia.note: Everything can be configured by the school and is optional for each user. Families with different levels of observance share the same school, and the app respects that.

bachillerato.label: In the design

items.title: Pathways and electives
items.body: Choosing a track and electives with clear information for students and families.

items.title: Research project
items.body: Tracked in stages, with dates, partial hand-ins and tutor feedback.

items.title: University entrance exam prep (PAU)
items.body: Calendar, materials and mock exams organised by subject.

items.title: University guidance
items.body: Information on degrees and universities, including the option of studying in Israel.

profesorado.title: For teachers and leadership
profesorado.intro: If teachers don't save time, the app is useless. That's why the teacher dashboard is the first thing we designed.

items.title: Teacher dashboard
items.body: Their groups, what needs marking and what's happening today, on one screen.

items.title: Fast marking
items.body: Mark, comment and grade without switching screens.

items.title: Templates
items.body: Reusable homework, rubrics and notices from one year to the next.

items.title: Tutor's class view
items.body: Grades, attendance and notes for the whole class at a glance.

items.title: Spotting students at risk
items.body: Early signals when absences, missed hand-ins or low grades pile up.

items.title: Timetable builder
items.body: Timetables, rooms and cover with conflict warnings.

items.title: Exportable reports
items.body: Reports by student, class or stage, ready to download.

items.title: Bulk import
items.body: Students, groups and staff imported from a spreadsheet.

privacidad.title: Privacy and security
privacidad.intro: We are talking about children's data. This is what we commit to, in writing, before we start.

items.title: The data belongs to the school
items.body: The school is the data controller. We only process data on its instructions.

items.title: GDPR and LOPDGDD
items.body: Designed to comply with the General Data Protection Regulation and Spanish law.

items.title: Hosted in the EU
items.body: Data is stored on servers inside the European Union.

items.title: Encryption
items.body: Information encrypted in transit and at rest.

items.title: Two-step verification
items.body: Mandatory for teachers and administration.

items.title: Sensitive data kept separate
items.body: The most delicate information is stored apart, with more restricted access.

items.title: Impact assessment
items.body: Before launch, because it involves children's data.

items.title: No advertising or model training
items.body: The data is not used for advertising or to train artificial intelligence models.

items.title: Free export
items.body: The school can export all its data whenever it wants.

futuro.title: Where it could grow
futuro.intro: Extensions we have in mind for later. They are not part of the first pilot.
items: AI study assistant, under the school's control

empezamos.intro: No changing everything at once. We start small, learn with you and grow once it works.

seguridad.title: Your data, protected to the highest standards
seguridad.intro: We handle information from communities, families and businesses. That's why security isn't an add-on: it's the foundation of everything we build.

items.title: Encryption at rest
items.body: All stored information is encrypted with AES-256, the same standard used by banks and public administrations.

items.title: Encryption in transit
items.body: Data always travels over HTTPS with TLS 1.3 between the device and our servers, so no one can read it along the way.

items.title: Google Cloud infrastructure
items.body: Our apps run on Google Cloud: data centres with round-the-clock physical security, protection against attacks and continuous monitoring.

items.title: Data hosted in the European Union
items.body: Data is stored in Google Cloud's European regions and governed by EU regulations.

items.title: GDPR and LOPDGDD
items.body: We comply with the General Data Protection Regulation and Spain's data protection law.

items.title: ISO/IEC 27001
items.body: We work to ISO/IEC 27001, the international standard for information security management.
